title: Robust Representation Learning for Spiking Neural Networks based on Conditional Information Bottleneck
abstract: arXiv:2610.28110v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) have shown great potential for low-power neuromorphic computing due to their event-driven processing and spatiotemporal sparsity, but they remain vulnerable to input perturbations, hardware-intrinsic noise, and adversarial attacks in real-world deployment. We attribute this vulnerability partly to input-specific hidden representations learned by standard SNNs trained with conventional cross-entropy loss, as our information-plane analysis empirically shows that substantial input-related information can still be retained after label-predictive information becomes stable. translated_title: 基于条件信息瓶颈的脉冲神经网络鲁棒表示学习
translated_abstract: 脉冲神经网络凭借其事件驱动处理和时空稀疏性，在低功耗神经形态计算领域展现出巨大潜力，但在实际部署中仍然容易受到输入扰动、硬件固有噪声和对抗攻击的影响。我们将这种脆弱性部分归因于使用传统交叉熵损失训练的标准SNN所学习到的输入特定隐含表示，因为我们的信息平面分析经验性地表明，在标签预测信息趋于稳定之后，网络中仍会保留大量与输入相关的信息。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了SCIB，这是一种基于条件信息瓶颈的简单而有效的SNN鲁棒学习目标。与传统变分信息瓶颈方法不同，SCIB将互信息压缩项 I(X;S) 替换为条件互信息 I(X;S|Y)，并推导出一个易于处理的变分近似形式。
tldr: 该论文提出SCIB方法，通过在信息瓶颈框架中将互信息压缩项替换为条件互信息 I(X;S|Y)，抑制SNN隐含表示中与输入相关的冗余信息，从而显著提升脉冲神经网络对输入扰动、硬件噪声和对抗攻击的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SCIB, a robust learning objective for Spiking Neural Networks that replaces the mutual information compression term I(X;S) with conditional mutual information I(X;S|Y), suppressing input-specific information in hidden representations to improve robustness against perturbations, hardware noise, and adversarial attacks.
